comment: Shared paging vectors. cmd/ndpreview (Go layout.go) and lib/copperui/src/pack.cc (C++, through the generated lib/copperui/tests/pack_vectors.inc) must give these pages. A block is [height, gap, keepWithNext]; available is the height of a page body. pages[i] is the page index of block i.

cases.name: no keep: blocks fill pages in order
an empty body has one page
a block taller than a page gets a page of its own
a section label moves with its first row
a section label with room stays on the page
a field caption stays with its box
keepWithNext on the last block is ignored
a group taller than a page is packed block by block
the gap inside a group counts: it fits
the gap inside a group counts: it does not
a radio title stays with all its options
